description: Preview a project file (a cruma.yaml or cruma.toml in the user's repo) without exposing anything: loads and validates it and returns what applying it would add (frontends, backends, hosted processes, sections that are ignored). A parse, validation or literal-secret failure names the file and field. Set create=true to create the file, with empty sections, when it does not exist. Show the user the summary and ask before calling apply_project. One project per connection; a second window attaching the same file shares it. Local-socket connections only.

create.description: Create the file, with empty sections, when it does not exist. Default: false.

path.description: Path of the project file (`.yaml`, `.yml` or `.toml`). Absolute and `~/` paths are accepted.

name: attach_project
